purpose: Compose labels, descriptions, and errors for grouped controls that do not ship built-in field chrome.

notes: Use VeliProvider when FieldLabel needs localized optional labeling.

useWhen: A RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup needs a visible label, description, or error message.
Form library validation errors should render through FieldError inside the group.

avoidWhen.situation: The control already exposes label, description, and error props.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use the built-in field props on Input, Select, and similar controls.

supportedInteractions: Label association through React Aria LabelContext
approvedPatterns: Place FieldLabel, FieldDescription, and FieldError inside RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup.
Do not also pass description or errorMessage on the group when using FieldDescription or FieldError.
Pass form-library errors into FieldError.errors when integrating React Hook Form or TanStack Form.
limitations: Field does not wrap every control; prefer built-in props when a component already provides them.
Duplicating group-level description or errorMessage with Field parts shows the text twice.
accessibility: FieldLabel uses React Aria Label semantics and LabelContext.
FieldError exposes invalid feedback for the associated group.
responsive: Field parts follow the surrounding group layout and orientation.
rtl: Label and message layout follow the active reading direction.
